column3: [lazy, yawning] Ugh, I'm so tired of being stuck here all day!
[surprised] Huh? Why are you lying here? Move! You're blocking the way!
[impatient] Forget this lazybones. The lungs are already rushing us!
[annoyed] Fine. You're off the hook today. Come on, let's take the road below.
[exhausted, angry] Ugh, I've had enough. Every day I work overtime, holding the mouth open, while the nose just lies around doing nothing!
[tired] What choice do we have? If we stop working, our owner can't breathe.
[frustrated] But we shouldn't do all this for nothing. He needs to know how tired we are.
[sly] Let's give him a makeover. Then he'll get it.
[sad] Why do I keep getting uglier?
[calm, clear] Years of mouth breathing while you're growing can change your face. A long face, a narrow jaw, crowded teeth. If your nose is always blocked, get it checked.
